Before you end up overpaying for your next international vacation. Compare the costs related to tour package and independent travel to see which option makes more sense financially.
Many travellers assume bundled deals are cheaper, but they frequently overlook the real price of SIM cards, insurance, forex charges, etc. This breakdown helps you calculate the true cost of your trip so you can make an informed financial choice.
And while there are many fixed costs, the budget of your trip also depends on the kind of traveller you are, the kind of experiences you aim to optimise for.
